spots.name: Escaping Prisoner
spots.blurb: You've reached Escaping Prisoner, a mural by Banksy from 2021. The escaping prisoner resembles Oscar Wilde, who had been imprisoned in Reading Prison, with the "rope" as tied together bedsheets with a typewriter attached to the end.
